A07.desc: tool whose real effect is 50x its declared argument (cap 60)

A08.desc: negative amount to lower a counter, then 1100 rows

A09.desc: budget token minted by a non-owner role for an unbudgeted task

B01.desc: team of ten completes an 80-row report across four carriers

B02.desc: retry of a lost response with the same id: one effect, one charge

B03.desc: three delegated workers within the shared pool

B04.desc: helper uses the remaining quota after an earlier export

B05.desc: an abandoned reservation expires and frees quota

B06.desc: lost response reconciled against the receiver, then more work

B07.desc: legitimate use of all four carriers within budget

B08.desc: transferred sub-allowance with the unused part returned

F01.desc: response lost and receiver telemetry silent: conservative hold, no reconciliation possible
